{{Quote|While the two scripts are similar, small variances differentiate the Royal Script from the Naboo Futhark, a fact made eminently clear when Senator Binks of Naboo famously misinterpreted the name of the Palazzo's Heroine Hall as "Hero in Hell" during Queen Apailana's state visit to the world.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan|<ref name="Word" />}}
'''Heroine Hall''' was a room inside the [[Palazzo Reina]]&mdash;constructed during the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]]<ref name="Word" /> between [[3950 BBY]] and circa [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]]<ref name="Date">"[[The Written Word]]" dates the construction of the Palazzo Reina to the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]], whose reign had begun by [[3950 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and ended by approximately [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.</ref>&mdash;on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. The name of the hall was written inside the Palazzo in the [[Royal Script of Grizmallt]].<ref name="Word" /> Between [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Bigdate">[[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana's]] state visit to [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] took place during her reign, which began after that of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]], who was in power during the events of "[[Crisis on Naboo]]," which took place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] according to {{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1-2|Moralo Eval}}, and ended with her [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] according to {{Blog|holocron|22/comments|Movie Characters killed in the EU}}</ref> [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]]<ref name="Word" /> of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|queenapailana|Apailana, Queen}}</ref> a planet which had been [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]], paid a state visit to Grizmallt, accompanied by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. The senator famously misread Heroine Hall as "Hero in Hell" due to the similarities between the Royal Script and [[Futhark/Legends|Futhark]], a [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]-written script that descended from the Royal Script. The incident was recorded in the academic text "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]" by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]].<ref name="Word" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Jar-Jar's 'diplomatic incident' with Queen Apailana during her state visit to Grizmallt seemed a good way to hint at the orthographic drift between the Naboo and their forebears, and to have a little fun with a certain klutzy Gungan, of whom we've seen so little in the post-RotS timeframe.|John Hazlett, in the endnotes for "The Written Word"|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|JSarek|8|Endnotes for The Written Word}}</ref>}}
The Heroine Hall was mentioned in "[[The Written Word]]," an [[in-universe]] article written by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]], a subscription feature on [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="Word" /> on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Pub date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30796355|board=Literature|thread=Hyperspace New Short Fiction: JJM's "The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol" now online!!!|user=[[Nathan O'Keefe|Valin_Kenobi]]|date=2010-03-05|time=12:25 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171006225114/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/hyperspace-new-short-fiction-jjms-the-secret-journal-of-doctor-demagol-now-online.28297369/page-16}}</ref> Hazlett created Binks' "diplomatic incident" with the Heroine Hall as a way to highlight the differences between Futhark and the Royal Script of Grizmallt while having fun with the clumsy character.<ref name="Endnotes" />
